AI status compatible: Springer Nature permits AI support for research, basic statistical analysis and drafting literature reviews or summaries with human validation. This supports analytical assistance and substantive drafting, not autonomous authorship. Added both official 2025 impact factors; they do not estimate acceptance.
findings.resolution: Retain conservative fee and author-geography statuses and the policy limitations; consult linked journal and publisher evidence before submission.

notes: All 19 baseline and discovery records and all three role patches reviewed. Publisher AI policies and selected fee, geographic and metrics evidence independently checked; findings retain per-candidate uncertainties. Historical source-backed metrics are preserved without difficulty labels.

Springer Nature publisher guidance requires version, dates, prompts and contribution extent, in addition to placement of declarations; corrections preserve the full AI policy fields.
